title: Bus Arbiter with Lock
constraints: Three masters, fixed priority (master 0 highest). Registered one-hot grant.
Each rising edge: if the current owner still requests **and** asserts its `lock` bit, it keeps the bus. Otherwise the highest-priority requester gets it. With no requests, `gnt = 0`.
`owner` = index of the granted master (0 when none). `busy = |gnt`. Synchronous reset: nobody owns the bus.
hints: Keep the grant register. The locked case is `gnt[i] && req[i] && lock[i]` for the current owner i.
Otherwise it's a plain fixed-priority encoder on `req`.
Lock is how a master performs atomic read-modify-write sequences on a shared bus.

examples.title: lock
examples.input: master 2 owns the bus with lock, master 0 requests
